title: Two papers disagree (diet-and-mortality)
explanation: Claim A asserts that unprocessed red meat consumption has no association with incident stroke, whereas Claim B states that it is associated with an increased risk of stroke.
a_text: Unprocessed red meat consumption is not associated with incident stroke.
b_text: Consumption of 100 g/day of unprocessed red meat is associated with an 11% increased risk of stroke.

consumer.headline: Two papers report findings that disagree
